lane_vocabulary.cross-target: a named build/target architecture pair with an actual compatible runtime for the produced artifact; emulator or remote worker behavior is independently identified
lane_vocabulary.remote-worker: separate explicitly configured and authenticated BuildKit worker with disconnect/cancel/unknown-outcome evidence; not a local VM or an open socket
lane_vocabulary.private-registry: real local/private OCI Distribution registry plus independent pull/run consumer and bounded credentials; no public publication inferred
lane_vocabulary.platform-time: qualified native OS sleep/wake, logout/login, reboot and clock/DST fixture evidence; container clock manipulation or synthetic timestamps alone cannot stand in

lane_vocabulary.crypto-interop: independently generated and checked DSSE/Ed25519 exact-payload fixtures against the production signature adapter; same-code sign/verify is not independent evidence
lane_vocabulary.recipient-isolated: separate recipient user/home/store with producer store, source cache and worker physically inaccessible; a second directory under one mounted producer home does not count
lane_vocabulary.systemd-linux: systemd user manager on linux (present in this WSL2 host)
lane_vocabulary.launchd: native launchd on macOS — absent on this workstation; a generic e2e-macos job does not qualify installed-job lifecycle cases
